question: Can intact pretrained Qwen blocks contribute useful capability when the architecture makes the donor pathway structurally necessary?
primary_metric: development macro token-NLL (mean of language and math, host tokenizer, seed-42 16+16 development protocol identical to Campaign 3)

gates.A_integrity: single path; pinned intact frozen donor; identical-logit reconstruction; causality tests pass
gates.B_pretrained_benefit: pretrained macro <= 0.98 x matched random-twin macro
gates.C_donor_dependence: full macro <= 0.98 x bypass_graft macro AND <= 0.98 x zero_graft macro
gates.D_useful_performance: language NLL <= 1.50 x host language NLL AND macro <= 5.7396 (Campaign 3 dense control, identical protocol)
gates.E_replication: seed-123 pretrained/twin pair preserves Gate B direction (finalists only)

controls: Campaign 3 dense/attention references from verified records
